description: Stop monitoring a watched handle and free its slot. Pass the watch id from namesniper_watches, or a username (optionally narrowed to one platform) to remove all its watches. Returns JSON with the removed count and ids. Requires an API key.

platform.description: Limit username-based removal to one platform

userId.description: Ignored - derived from your API key

username.description: Remove watches for this username across all platforms unless platform is given

name: namesniper_unwatch
